integrity: Analytical coarea and piecewise-affine argument with exact rational exhaustive finite cut and branch certificates and an explicit exact attaining pair. The finite enumeration applies only to this fixed five-vertex object; there has been no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact graph is the unweighted five-cycle; input signals are real and nonnegative and the operator uses graph metric balls; the seminorm is cycle-edge total variation. No extension to longer cycles, weighted graphs, or signed absolute-value input maps is asserted. Originality is assessed against the available relevant literature and recorded comparable results; unindexed antecedents cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp two-input graph-variation amplification by uncentered pentagonal maximal averaging
